owonrin-examples.ifa

Owonrin: Random Numbers

Random number generation using pese (returns 0 to arg-1).

Use Case 1: Dice Rolling

// dice.ifa - Roll dice using single-arg random

ese roll_dice(count, sides) {
    ayanmo results = [];
    ayanmo i = 0;

    nigba (i < count) {
        // pese(sides) returns 0..sides-1, so add 1
        ayanmo roll = Owonrin.pese(1, sides);
        results = Ogunda.fi(results, roll);
        i = i + 1;
    }

    pada results;
}

Irosu.fo("Rolling 3d6: ");
ayanmo rolls = roll_dice(3, 6);
fun r ninu rolls {
    Irosu.fo("  " + r);
}

// Sum the rolls
ayanmo total = 0;
fun r ninu rolls {
    total = Obara.fikun(total, r);
}
Irosu.fo("Total: " + total);

Use Case 2: Coin Flip Simulator

// coin.ifa - Simulate coin flips

ese flip_coin() {
    ayanmo result = Owonrin.pese(0, 1); // 0 or 1
    ti (result == 0) {
        pada "Heads";
    }
    pada "Tails";
}

ese flip_multiple(count) {
    ayanmo heads = 0;
    ayanmo tails = 0;
    ayanmo i = 0;

    nigba (i < count) {
        ayanmo result = flip_coin();
        Irosu.fo(result);
        ti (result == "Heads") {
            heads = heads + 1;
        } bibẹkọ {
            tails = tails + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }

    Irosu.fo("Heads: " + heads + ", Tails: " + tails);
}

flip_multiple(10);

Use Case 3: Random Password Generator

// password.ifa - Simple password generator

ayanmo CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789";

ese generate_password(length) {
    ayanmo password = "";
    ayanmo i = 0;
    ayanmo char_count = Ika.len(CHARS);

    nigba (i < length) {
        ayanmo idx = Owonrin.pese(0, Ika.len(CHARS));
        // Use Ika.ge (slice) to extract one char
        password = Ika.so(password, Ika.ge(CHARS, idx, idx + 1));
        i = i + 1;
    }

    pada password;
}

Irosu.fo("Password Generator");
ayanmo i = 0;
nigba (i < 5) {
    ayanmo pwd = generate_password(12);
    Irosu.fo(pwd);
    i = i + 1;
}
